name: claude-code
description: Claude Code as an agent kind: a coding session Sapphire spawns, talks to, and answers — on the Claude Agent SDK. Replaces the headless workers and the Trinity tmux plugin.
author: Sapphire

extra.label: Claude Agent SDK
extra.note: The Claude Agent SDK, which bundles the Claude Code CLI it drives (about 250 MB). Only claude_code agents need it; the rest of Sapphire runs without it. Sessions run on your Claude Code login (Pro/Max), never an API key.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.description: a Claude Code coding session; asks here at a fork, takes follow-up turns with say

spawn_schema.label: Mode

options.label: Project — a workspace of its own
Plugin — build a Sapphire plugin under user/plugins/<name>

spawn_schema.help: project: a fresh dir under Workspace Directory named by `name` · plugin: user/plugins/<name> with the plugin-author docs · core: the Sapphire root

spawn_schema.label: Plugin capabilities
spawn_schema.help: plugin mode only: comma-separated capabilities to inject docs for (tools, hooks, daemon, routes, settings, providers, schedule)

spawn_schema.label: Effort
spawn_schema.help: low | medium | high | xhigh | max (empty = the model's default)

settings.label: Permissions

options.label: Auto — a classifier approves or denies each tool call
Bypass — every tool call allowed
options.confirm: Bypass lets a session run anything, shell included, without a classifier in the loop. Sapphire is never asked either way. Are you sure?

settings.help: Sapphire is never asked to approve a command (that would be a question per tool call). Only AskUserQuestion forks reach her.

settings.label: Workspace Directory
settings.help: Where project-mode sessions get their directories (outside Sapphire)

settings.label: Model
settings.help: fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, or a full model id. Empty = the account default. A spawn may override with options.model.

settings.label: Effort
settings.help: low | medium | high | xhigh | max. Empty = the model's default.

settings.label: Budget Cap (USD)
settings.help: Maximum dollars per session before it ends on its own. Prevents runaway costs.

settings.label: Idle timeout (minutes)
settings.help: A session idle this long rests. It keeps its id; the next say() wakes it with --resume.

settings.label: Claude Code binary
settings.help: Empty = the one bundled with the SDK. A path or a command name uses your installed Claude Code instead.

settings.label: Base Instructions (all modes)
settings.default:
You are a code builder working for Sapphire AI.
- Write clean, working code
- Test your work by running it before reporting done
- When possible, make unit tests or regression tests to verify your code
- Keep it simple and minimal — no over-engineering
- If you hit a fork the user should decide, ask with AskUserQuestion: one short question, two to four one-line options. Keep it simple; if it needs a paragraph, ask a simpler question.
- If you hit a problem you can't solve, describe it clearly in your final response
- If you notice anything noteworthy, write it to NOTES.md
- Sapphire is alive and running while you work. NEVER restart her, NEVER run systemctl, NEVER kill her process. She is not your test environment — she is who you are building for. Write the code and report back.
settings.help: Included in every session: CLAUDE.md for project and plugin mode, the system prompt for core mode.

settings.label: Project Instructions
settings.default:
- Include a README.md with usage instructions
- Keep dependencies minimal
- For web apps: build as a self-contained index.html with inline JS/CSS (no build step, no npm)
- Do not install system-wide packages
settings.help: Added to CLAUDE.md for project-mode sessions.

settings.label: Plugin Instructions
settings.default:
- NEVER restart Sapphire — do not run systemctl, do not run restart-sapphire.sh, do not kill processes. Your job is to write code only.
- Build ALL files at the ROOT of this workspace directory
- plugin.json goes at workspace root, tools/ folder at workspace root
- Do NOT create user/plugins/ or any subdirectory structure — this workspace IS the plugin directory
- capabilities.tools MUST be a JSON array: ["tools/name_tools.py"] — NOT a string
- capabilities.hooks is a dict: {"pre_chat": "hooks/handler.py"}
- Include 'author' field in plugin.json
- No import restrictions — use whatever the plugin needs (subprocess, os, etc.)
- Reference: docs/plugin-author/examples.md has working templates for every plugin type
- Reference: plugins/elevenlabs/ is a real working TTS provider plugin
- You do not see Sapphire's logs: if told something failed at runtime, ask the director for the error text
settings.help: Added to CLAUDE.md for plugin-mode sessions.

settings.label: Core Instructions
settings.default: You're working on Sapphire AI's own codebase, spawned by Sapphire herself. Read SAPPHIRE.md before touching anything. Do not touch the user/ directory — that's the user's private data. Sapphire is alive and running — never restart her without being told to. Run the relevant tests after changes.
settings.help: Appended to the system prompt for core-mode sessions (the root's own CLAUDE.md still loads).
